title: Crispy Satay Corn Fritters
description: A delicious twist on traditional satay, these crispy fritters are filled with sweet corn and served with a side of spicy peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: unique spice blend
ingredients.notes: mix of coriander, cumin, and chili powder

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, unique spice blend, and a pinch of salt.
2. In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and corn kernels.
3. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
4. Heat 1/2 cup of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
5. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the hot oil.
6. Flatten the batter slightly with a spatula and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.
8. Serve hot with a side of spicy peanut sauce (see notes)
